verdict.rationale: Grafana has no documented native bulk-action feature (select many, edit/delete/move at once). Bulk change is possible indirectly: file-based provisioning and observability-as-code let users define many dashboards and data sources in version-controlled files and deploy them via CI/CD. A CLI and an OpenAPI spec also support scripted administrative tasks. missing for 10: explicit bulk edit/delete/move operations in UI or API, documentation of batch endpoints, hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows (e.g., via CLI or MCP).
